newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MATCH HELD UP AS STRACHAN REFUSES TO GO OFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MATCH HELD UP AS STRACHAN REFUSES TO GO OFF.

text.p: Ex-Scottish international midfielder Gordon Strachan could face a serious disciplinary charge after causing the temporary abandonment of Coventry City's reserve match at West Bromwich Albion on Thursday.
Strachan refused to go off after being dismissed for foul language. Referee Tony Green left the pitch and called the teams' managers to meet him in his dressing room.
The game was finally re-started -- without Strachan -- after a 14-minute delay.
